# Lifestyle Money Management

> Lifestyle Money Management (LMM) helps Australians build long-term wealth through ethical, evidence-led, property-led strategy, financial analysis and portfolio management. Led by Nick Foale, Managing Director, with more than 26 years of experience in the finance industry. Focus markets: Adelaide, Brisbane, Queensland and selected Australian residential growth locations.

## Key facts

## Services
- Investment Strategy: location and property-type strategy, risk-adjusted growth and yield filters, personal goal and timeline alignment
- Financial Analysis: borrowing and serviceability review, cash-flow stress testing, exit, buffer and contingency planning
- Portfolio Management: portfolio balance and exposure review, upgrade, hold or sell decision support, ongoing performance and lending checks
